name: Review findings
description: Repo-local WorkContext message example for recording Relay code review findings; not a universal Relay review schema.

fields.scope: Relay issue, PR, diff, or code area reviewed.
fields.exactHead: Branch and commit SHA reviewed so stale-head approvals are obvious.
fields.verdict: Reviewer disposition such as approved, blocked, or needs-follow-up.
fields.findings: Evidence-backed findings with severity, file/line when available, and recommended fix.
fields.scopeResult: Whether the implementation satisfies, partially satisfies, or misses the acceptance scope.
fields.followUps: Non-blocking follow-up work that should survive the current PR, if any.

example.summary: Review findings for PR #123 at abc1234: blocked on missing QA evidence template

findings.issue: QA evidence needs its own repo-local template instead of reusing a QA handoff template.
findings.recommendedChange: Add a qa-evidence template with exact-head, commands, scenario evidence, status, and blockers fields.
